---
name: Quarterly maintenance
about: Manual maintenance checks that are not automated
title: Quarterly maintenance
assignees: ExMember
---

Merging to `main` deploys to GitHub Pages.

- [ ] Add this issue to the [Cohere Product Work Board](https://github.com/orgs/cohere-coop/projects/1) under "Ready for implementation"
- [ ] Check that it works: https://guides.ncmanager.org
- [ ] Review and merge the Dependabot PRs for gems and GitHub Actions
- [ ] Update `.ruby-version` to the current stable Ruby: https://www.ruby-lang.org/
- [ ] Merge into `main` and check that it deployed: https://github.com/cohere-coop/ncmanager-guides/actions
- [ ] Check that it still works: https://guides.ncmanager.org
